name: Framed
description: The absolute gold standard of daily movie puzzles. It displays one single high-quality screenshot from a hidden movie. Guess wrong to reveal more frames.

name: Cine2Nerdle (The Daily Burgle)
description: An intense, grid-based puzzle game for hardcore cinema buffs. Link interconnected words, actors, or plots to solve the daily movie heist puzzle.

name: Moviedle
description: A fast-paced visual guessing game. It compresses an entire 2-hour movie into a rapid 1-second fast-forward clip. Guess the film from flashes of light.

name: The Movie Database (TMDB)
description: The premier community-built, open-source alternative to IMDb. Crowd-sourced, devoid of bloated ads, housing massive galleries of artwork and deep trivia.

name: Box Office Mojo
description: The financial bible of movie geeks. A massive live dashboard tracking global and domestic film grosses, budgets, and weekend box office stats.

name: WhatSong
description: A search engine built to answer: 'What song was playing during that specific scene?' Maps movie soundtracks scene-by-scene with descriptions.

name: JustWatch India
description: A massive interactive clearinghouse mapping where every movie is streaming. Filter by rating, price, and platform without needing to log in.

name: TasteDive
description: A contextual recommendation explorer. Type in any movie you love, and it map-generates a clean list of related films, shows, and books.

name: Letterboxd (Explore Mode)
description: Turns the famous social network into an aesthetic discovery board. Browse popular community lists like 'Visually Stunning Cyberpunk' without logging in.

name: Nothing to Watch
description: A neat tool designed to help you quickly choose what to watch based on simple filters, escaping decision paralysis.
